title: Football Kit
statementMd:
Consider a football tournament where $*n*$ teams participate. Each team has two football kits: for home games, and for away games. The kit for home games of the $*i*$-th team has color $*x*_{*i*}$ and the kit for away games of this team has color $*y*_{*i*}$ $(*x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*})$.

In the tournament, each team plays exactly one home game and exactly one away game with each other team ($*n*(*n* - 1)$ games in total). The team, that plays the home game, traditionally plays in its home kit. The team that plays an away game plays in its away kit. However, if two teams has the kits of the same color, they cannot be distinguished. In this case the away team plays in its home kit.

Calculate how many games in the described tournament each team plays in its home kit and how many games it plays in its away kit.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ $(2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of teams. Next $*n*$ lines contain the description of the teams. The $*i*$-th line contains two space-separated numbers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}; *x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*})$ — the color numbers for the home and away kits of the $*i*$-th team.

## Output

For each team, print on a single line two space-separated integers — the number of games this team is going to play in home and away kits, correspondingly. Print the answers for the teams in the order they appeared in the input.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

考虑一场有 $*n*$ 支球队参加的足球锦标赛。每支球队有两套足球服：一套用于主场比赛，另一套用于客场比赛。第 $*i*$ 支球队的主场球衣颜色为 $*x*_{*i*}$，客场球衣颜色为 $*y*_{*i*}$ $(*x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*})$。

在这场锦标赛中，每支球队与其他每支球队各进行一场主场比赛和一场客场比赛（总共进行 $*n*(*n* - 1)$ 场比赛）。进行主场比赛的球队通常穿着主场球衣，进行客场比赛的球队穿着客场球衣。但是，如果两支球队的球衣颜色相同，就无法将它们区分开来。在这种情况下，客场球队会穿着主场球衣。

请计算在上述锦标赛中，每支球队有多少场比赛穿着主场球衣，以及有多少场比赛穿着客场球衣。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$，表示球队的数量。接下来 $*n*$ 行描述各支球队。第 $*i*$ 行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*x*_{*i*}$、$*y*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}; *x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*})$，分别表示第 $*i*$ 支球队主场球衣和客场球衣的颜色编号。

## 输出格式

对于每支球队，单独一行输出两个用空格分隔的整数，分别表示该球队将穿着主场球衣和客场球衣进行的比赛场数。请按照球队在输入中出现的顺序输出答案。
